newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends firmer on fund influx.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends firmer on fund influx.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed higher against its U.S. counterpart on Friday due to an influx of foreign equity funds aimed at the island's bullish stock market, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.534 against Thursday's T$27.543 finish.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$241 million.
The local stock market had gained nearly 400 points in eight consecutive sessions before easing on Friday.
"Expectation that the stock market will continue to rise drew a lot of foreign funds into Taiwan," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
But she added the local currency still faced resistance to further appreciation from a strong U.S. dollar overseas.
A T$27.52-58 range was seen for Saturday.
